definitions.explanation: Without holding back or being reluctant to give or use something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{惜|お}しげもなく⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{惜|お}しげもなく⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: He generously shared his knowledge with me.

examples.japanese: {高級食材|こうきゅうしょくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{惜|お}しげもなく⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a dish made generously with high-quality ingredients.

notes:
Means to do something without any reluctance or stinginess — freely, generously, unstintingly. Implies that the thing given or used is valuable, making the generosity noteworthy.

COMMON PATTERNS:
From ⟦{惜|お}しい→惜しい：10243_oshii⟧ (regrettable, precious) + げ (appearance suffix) + ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ + ⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without). Literally: "without even an air of reluctance."
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{惜|お}しげもなく⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use ~ generously
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{惜|お}しげもなく⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to give ~ without holding back
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{惜|お}しげもなく⟦{注|そそ}ぐ→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧: to pour ~ unstintingly

REGISTER:
Somewhat literary. Often appears in written descriptions of lavish use of resources, time, or effort.

cross_references.label: to regret, to be reluctant to part with, to begrudge, to spare
